## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` has a line for any change to what the skill does
- [ ] Generic files stay language-neutral; mandatory rules are stated briefly in `skills/SKILL.md`, in full in "Rule details" in `skills/WORKFLOW.md`, and in the file that carries them out; sources go in `skills/references/`
- [ ] Links, file names, quoted section names, and rule numbers this change touches still point at something
- [ ] Behavior changes were measured before and after, or this says why not
